pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal patches with moderately jagged edges and sharp pixel gradients at the boundaries. The patches show high contrast against the lighter inter-patch spacing.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of wide, cream-colored pathways. The topological graph displays frequent tri-radiate junction nodes with consistent pixel thickness throughout the visible flank area.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the neck and shoulder displays a jagged silhouette with high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations consisting of dark brown vertical bristles.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least four dark-toned avian organisms (oxpeckers) perched along the dorsal mane and upper neck interface.
